newsitem.title: UK: London freight - Firmer trend is hard to see yet.
newsitem.headline: London freight - Firmer trend is hard to see yet.

text.p: Despite the view of some brokers that sentiment had changed and one or two reported Panamax fixtures suggesting a trend in owners' favour in certain areas, the freight market continued to drift lower.

It was variously described as 'sleepy' and 'rather soggy', especially in the early positions. The BFI lost ground again, down 8 points to 1434, and the Baltic Handy Index lost 5 points to 1099, falling below 100 for the first time for a month.

Dreyfus quickly booked the Caper New Luck for 80,000/5 barley Rouen and Le Havre/Dammam for 20/25 April at $18.75 basis 2-1 with other options including 90,000/5 Rouen and La Pallice/Jeddah at $16.50 2-1. Geepee are in the market for a Caper for grain for US Gulf to Saudi Arabia for end April. Nearby positions in the US Gulf continued weak for Panamaxes.

The 1982-built Seatrans-relet Heraklia 65,159 dwt and the 1983-built Torm Asia-relet Myra 64,879 dwt were rumoured to have both fixed delivery US Gulf for trips to the Far East at around $13,500 daily plus $225,000 bonus. Significantly Beauty Sea 69,365 dwt was said to have ballasted from USG to Brazil to fix transatlantic business. A number of Panamaxes were booked for timecharter trips from Argentina or Brazil to the East at steady rates between $13,500 and 14,500 daily plus bonuses between $290,000 and $350,000. The 1981-built Samsun-relet Evgenia 69,428 dwt was taken by Finagrain delivery prompt Morocco for a trip via E Coast S America to the Far East at a less impressive $12,500 daily.
Shipmair were linked with the 1981-built Pretty Lady 61,776 dwt delivery spot Rio Grande for 4-6 months at $10,500 daily plus unknown bonus.

New enquiry from S America today included Continental 52,000 heavy grain Up River and Bahia Blanca or Necochea/Port Llang Singapore or Butterworth 23 April/6 May and Interbulk a Panamax for meals Paranagua/Lisbon-Hamburg range for end April. Possible orders were quoted by Dreyfus 50,000 grains Plate and completion/Continent end April and Toepfer 55,000 heavy grain santos/continent end april. From the US Gulf Continental quoted 48/61,000 grains 51' to Jeddah and Dammam for 23/28 April, Cargill 55/80,000 any grains to Gibraltar-Hamburg option Seaforth 23/28 April, Dreyfus 54,000 heavy grain USG/Japan any 15 days 28 April/23 May, and CNAN 20,000 and 30,000 maize to Algeria 1/15 and 15/25 May respectively. Elsewhere Andre have 18,000 wheat Thunder Bay/Tunisia 28 April/7 May and Glencore 25,000 wheat Immingham/Spanish Med for prompt loading.

Period business involving large Capers was concluded by Krupp in deals which involved other features in addition to the bare fixture reports. Wah Kwong newbuilding tonnage was fixed for delivery late 1998 or early 1999 for 1 or 2 years, possibly longer, and Grand Phoenix 290,000 dwt is believed to have already delivered for 12 months business including wet and dry trading at about $22,500 daily. Anangel Splendour 161,000 dwt was fixed by Showa delivery China mid April for an E Australian round at $15,000 daily but failed on subjects and the charterers took instead Good News 138,484 dwt delivery China at $13,500 daily.

Talk was heard that China Ssteel booked Mmaritime Oomi 73,350 dwt New Mangalore/Kaohsiung at $6.95. In the Atlantic Pan Ocean fixed Tigris 123,000 dwt deliveryt prompt Continent for between 2 and 4.5 months at $7,600 daily with a final month upto 5.5 altogether at $8,100 daily.
